Smart noise removal in League Proximity Chat uses these files, unchanged, from
@sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor 0.4.1 (https://github.com/sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor):
workletProcessor.js (its dist/rnnoise/workletProcessor.js), rnnoise.wasm and rnnoise_simd.wasm.

They contain:
- web-noise-suppressor, MIT License (text below)
- @shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm 2022.2.0, Apache License 2.0, Copyright Shiguredo Inc.
  (https://github.com/shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm, license: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
- RNNoise, BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2017 Mozilla, (c) 2007-2017 Jean-Marc Valin,
  (c) 2005-2017 Xiph.Org Foundation, (c) 2003-2004 Mark Borgerding
  (https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise, license: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise/blob/main/COPYING)
